messages.subject: Northlight v2 creative — ready for your eyes
messages.body:
Hi,

v2 came back from Northlight this afternoon. They've given us two options for the lead on the HCP email: A leads with claim 4 (the comparison), B leads with the nurse support programme.

I prefer A, it's the strongest hook we have. Can we go through both on Thursday in our 1:1?

Folder link: https://example.com/shared/kestrel/northlight-v2

Anika

messages.subject: Congress poster — the slide with the claim 4 data
messages.body:
As promised, slide 12 from the poster. This is the only place the comparison data exists right now — the manuscript is still under review as far as I know.

Anika

messages.subject: Re: today
messages.body:
Anika,

Thanks — good session. Confirming: we go with option B for the MLR pack and park claim 4 for now. The poster data isn't enough and Zeynep isn't comfortable with comparative wording until the paper is published. MLR would bounce it and cost us a cycle we don't have.

Please check timing with Zeynep. I'll speak to Tomasz about the retainer.

Manager

messages.subject: Claim 4 — when can we expect the publication?
messages.body:
Hi Zeynep,

We're building the HCP launch email and I wanted to check where the Congress data is for claim 4. Is there a publication date? I think it's poster only at the moment.

Thanks,
Anika

messages.subject: Claim 4 publication timing
messages.body:
Zeynep,

Following up on Anika's note: is there an online publication date for the claim 4 data, or are we still poster-only? I need to know whether there's any realistic path to using the comparative wording before MLR.

If it isn't in print, I'll keep it out of the launch email.

Thanks,
Manager

messages.subject: Kestrel steering 26 Oct — actions
messages.body:
Thanks all, useful session. Actions:

- Manager: bring the rationale for the claim 4 position to the next steering (23 Nov)
- AO: MLR submission by 24 Nov, no slippage
- DH: confirm comms timeline with Regulatory
- HW: speak to Finance about agency spend

The board is keen on the strongest possible message at launch, so let's not lose claim 4 without a good reason.

Hannah

messages.subject: RE: Claim 4 — when can we expect the publication?
messages.body:
Hi both,

Sorry for the slow reply. Short version: the manuscript has been accepted in principle but there's no online date yet.

The poster alone doesn't meet our standard for a comparative statement, so I wouldn't be able to support the claim 4 wording in anything promotional until it's in print.

Happy to review the nurse programme version as soon as the MLR pack is in.

Zeynep

messages.subject: Northlight PO — extra creative round
messages.body:
Hi,

Northlight are asking for a PO for the extra v3 round: £18.4k including the pharmacist leave-behind adaptation. I said I'd check with you before pushing Finance.

Do you want me to go to Tomasz, or will you?

Anika

messages.subject: Northlight extra round — PO route
messages.body:
Tomasz,

Northlight need a PO for roughly £18.4k for an extra creative round (v3 plus the pharmacist leave-behind adaptation). Can this come from the launch contingency? Let me know what you need from me.

Manager

messages.subject: RE: Northlight extra round — PO route
messages.body:
Hi,

It would come from the launch contingency, but that line needs Hannah's sign-off for anything over £15k. If you can get me a one-line OK from her I can raise the PO the same day.

Tomasz

messages.subject: Launch comms date — moving to 9 Feb
messages.body:
Hi all,

Heads up following this morning's call with Regulatory and Supply. The first commercial supply release has slipped, so the earliest we can go with launch comms is Tuesday 9 Feb (it was Wednesday 3 Feb). Press embargo planning follows that date.

I'll send a revised comms timeline next week. Please update your plans. I'd treat 9 Feb as firm unless you hear otherwise.

Damla

messages.subject: Launch date — 9 Feb
messages.body:
Damla,

Thanks for the update. I've noted 9 February as the firm comms date and I'll treat the 3 February plan and calendar hold as superseded.

Please send the revised timeline and embargo plan when you have it. I need to brief Hannah before Monday.

Manager

messages.subject: Heron hospital pharmacy webinar — could you speak for 10 mins?
messages.body:
Hi,

Would you be up for 10 minutes on nurse-led support models at the Heron webinar on 3 Dec? Run-through is Monday 23rd at 10:30 if that works. No worries if not.

Aisha

messages.subject: Monday steering — agenda
messages.body:
Agenda for Monday:

- 1. Launch date and comms (Damla)
- 2. Claim 4 — where we landed and why (Manager)
- 3. Agency spend — extra round (Hannah / Tomasz)
- 4. MLR timeline (Anika)

The board will ask why we dropped claim 4, so please bring the full rationale, and an option if there is one.

Thanks,
Hannah

messages.subject: Claim 4 pub — quick update (not for the wider thread)
messages.body:
Quick one outside the thread.

I heard from the corresponding author: the editor is saying early to mid December for online, but they've been vague before so please don't plan on it.

If it does land I'd want two weeks to review the claim wording properly, and I'm on leave 14–18 Dec (Rahul Shah covers). Happy to talk before Monday.

Zeynep

messages.subject: MLR pack — on track, plus one question
messages.body:
Hi,

Pack goes in Tuesday as planned. One question: should I submit a variant with claim 4 as well, so we don't have to restart MLR if the paper comes through? It would add a few days now but might save weeks later.

Your call.

Anika

messages.subject: Re: Monday steering — agenda
messages.body:
Hannah,

Will do. Short version: Medical can't support claim 4 until the paper is published. I'll bring the detail and a proposal.

I also need your steer on the Northlight extra round — it's above the £15k limit and Tomasz needs your OK.

Manager

messages.subject: Claim 4 — options for Monday
messages.body:
On claim 4. Where we are:

- Not in the launch email because [pull reasons from my notes!!]
- Medical position: [Zeynep — check her email]
- Option: [TBC]

Budget: need OK on the extra round before

messages.subject: Northlight — v3 timings
messages.body:
Hi,

If we get the PO by Friday 27 Nov we can deliver v3 by 11 Dec. After that we're into the Christmas slowdown and it slips to mid January.

Lena

messages.subject: Steering prep tomorrow
messages.body:
Hi,

Can we use 20 mins tomorrow for the variant question and 10 for me (career stuff)?

Anika

messages.subject: Re: Steering prep tomorrow
messages.body:
Anika,

Yes — 20 minutes on the variant question, then 10 for your career conversation. Please bring the trade-off: what a claim 4 variant costs us now versus restarting MLR later.

Manager

messages.subject: Planned maintenance: Saturday 21 Nov, 22:00–02:00
messages.body: Email and file sharing will be intermittently unavailable during the window. No action needed.

messages.body: You have 2 modules outstanding. Please complete them by Monday 30 Nov.
